title: Cubical rigidification-preserving isomorphism to a tensor power
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G$ a commutative group scheme over $S$, and $\mathcal L=(L,r_L,\tau_L)$ and $\mathcal M=(M,r_M,\tau_M)$ cubical rigidified lines [def-sfb-cubical-rigidified-line]. For $n\in\mathbb N$, an isomorphism $f:M\simeq L^{\otimes n}$ of invertible modules is a cubical rigidification-preserving tensor-power isomorphism if its restriction along the identity, followed by the tensor product of $n$ copies of $r_L$, equals $r_M$, and it carries $\tau_M$ to the tensor product of $n$ copies of $\tau_L$ under the canonical factorwise tensor identifications. Equivalently, after every base change to a test scheme and in any simultaneous local frames of the eight factors of $\Theta_3(L)$, evaluate $\tau_M$ in the tensor frames transported by $f$: its scalar must equal the $n$th power of the scalar of $\tau_L$. At $n=0$ the tensor power, rigidification and cube section are the structure module, its identity rigidification and unit section. Pullbacks are tensor inverse images [def-pc-module-pullback].
